context_markdown:
This register records known, intentional differences between the supplied printed source and the current working edition. The choices are adopted for this edition; they do not reconstruct the original transcriber’s intentions.

All four movements and all 32 pages of the supplied scan were reviewed, with enlarged checks of identified passages. This is a working edition, not a new critical edition or an exhaustive guarantee of every small mark. The source is the Breitkopf & Härtel collected edition as reprinted by Dover, not an autograph.

Bar numbers restart with each movement and follow the native transcription. Movement II begins with a pickup; its tempo and key changes include split bars. First endings and split bars are not forcibly renumbered. Captions identify the target location; images retain musical context.

records.title: ED-001 — Historical cello treble clef modernized
records.body_markdown:
**Source:** The cello uses historical treble notation read an octave below its written treble pitch in this passage.

**Edition:** The passage is written in modern tenor clef at its intended sounding pitch.

**Editorial reason:** Adopt the existing modern clef notation to remove the historical octave ambiguity. The source-to-edition change is not an octave transposition of the sounding music. Where the source returns to bass or tenor clef within the displayed context, that boundary is retained.
